nodes.behavior: Require molecule lane; load candidate/profile; create worker pool, registry and archive.
Original candidate plus population.max(1)-1 lineage-only mutations; rejected mutations emit candidate_rejected.
Score accepted proposals concurrently, collect in request order; retain successful results in current and cumulative scored.
Rank/display cumulative scores, update records/history, snapshot and publish generation zero.
For each generation 1..=args.generations, subject to cooperative cancellation.
Rank cumulative scored; take population before matching current; fallback to all current if no matched parents.
Cycle parents modulo length; seed + generation*10000 + index; record proposal or rejection.
Score proposals concurrently; per-request failures emit worker_failed and are omitted from offspring.
Replace current with successful offspring; cumulative scored retains prior successes; rank/display cumulative results.
Emit generation_completed, snapshot and publish; bounded refresh delay checks cancellation.
Sync records, mark COMPLETE, emit run_finished, snapshot/final_state and publish.

retained_state.current: successful population from latest scoring batch
retained_state.scored: append-only successful results across all generations
retained_state.archive: event sequence, generation snapshots and final state
retained_state.seed: deterministic per-proposal and scoring seeds; scoring indexes compact after rejected proposals

candidate_scoring.parallelism: Between candidates only; capability evaluation within each candidate is sequential.
candidate_scoring.other_lanes: Engine paths only; CLI run_solver rejects non-molecule lanes.

failure_semantics.scoring_failure: worker_failed; omit failed candidate; no retry in CLI loop
failure_semantics.capability_failure: ERROR envelope with NO_AUTHORITY, continue capability chain
failure_semantics.cancellation: cooperative return Ok without normal finalize at explicit checkpoints
failure_semantics.empty_current: Known v1 defect: subsequent parent indexing can panic; v2 must terminate truthfully instead of preserving panic.

limitations: mutate changes candidate identity and lineage, not structure
No CLI call to separate generate_compounds or numerical NSGA-II implementation
Source topology and annotations are a manually reviewed extraction, not a Rust execution trace
No durable restart/fencing semantics inferred from v1

v2_acceptance.first_goal: Synthetic deterministic adapters preserve orchestration, ordering, retained state and honest authority limits.
v2_acceptance.later_goal: Scientific implementations replace adapters behind versioned contracts; actual evolution requires separate evidence.
